observations: Whole then both supplied halves personally viewed before C/H. All 38 base crops, all eight adaptive crops and all three upright rotated crops personally read; exact crop boxes, scales and rotation angles are in crop_manifest.tsv. Entire typed prose read line by line, including accents, punctuation, singular/plural endings, line-end word joins and parenthesis closure. All cancellations, handwritten corrections and insertion endpoints checked; newly retained leaders are drawn. The two Zs in each exact sequence are single-stroke typed letters; the H3 coefficient G has an independently drawn inner upright. No readable watermark established. Archive 7 is comment only; manuscript 23 is transcribed. This is transcription collation, not a second audit or a check of the mathematical claims.
